rules.resident_memory: tracemalloc peak bytes measured over each candidate operation window
rules.update_cpu: live update plus any replay updates are charged together to max_update_cpu_seconds_per_event
rules.replay: every replay update is counted and charged; missing replay timing invalidates the point
rules.shared_overhead: candidate-specific orchestration overhead is charged to that candidate; evaluator-only world generation is excluded from learner resource comparison
rules.absent_feature_zero: a resource class may be exact zero only when the frozen candidate source exposes no invoked path for that class
